body:
MIM-only SSSOM now has an explicit decision for all **3,018 source mappings**: **1,763 supported** and **1,255 withheld**. Download `ingredient_mappings.sssom.tsv` for supported mappings. The separate `withheld_mappings.sssom.tsv` preserves every withheld source row; `mapping-dispositions.tsv` records all decisions and evidence references.

The release includes structural validation, evidence and source hash checks, adversarial review, and byte-identical clean-checkout reproduction. [PR #731](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/pull/731) records the changes and required CI results. All supported rows are `skos:exactMatch`. Complete review coverage does **not** mean all mappings are scientifically approved, and this release does not approve ingredient roles, components or downstream media regeneration.

The package supplies `manifest.json`, `README.md`, `SHA256SUMS` and a deterministic `mim-reviewed-sssom.tar.gz`. The README identifies the exact source commit. This SSSOM snapshot supersedes the SSSOM asset in [the earlier supported MIM release](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/releases/tag/mim-supported-2026-09-21); the earlier KGX snapshot remains a separate artifact.

See [reproduction and validation instructions](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/484082707b2a175cffebad3cbf46f3b39f66ca3d/docs/SSSOM_RELEASE.md), [SSSOM completion #729](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/729), and [adversarial review #730](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/730). Original confidence values and historical validation annotations are preserved; they are not newly calibrated probabilities.

All 16 PR checks and all 16 native merge-queue checks passed. The full queue suite passed 2,726 tests with six skipped; maintained-package coverage is 67%. The release reproduces from merged commit `484082707b2a175cffebad3cbf46f3b39f66ca3d`.
